content.text: {"id": "mm6246a3", "data_focus": {"v": "limited", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Patient 2's venous BLL dropped to 28.2 µ g/dL, from 33.5 µ g/dL."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "These two cases highlight the potential for lead poisoning among refugee populations"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "continuous", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Four months after discontinuing use of kajal, patient 2's venous BLL further declined to 22.1 µ g/dL"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Quantitative analysis of the kajal found 54% lead by weight"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Two male children in New Mexico, aged 20 and 4 months, were found to have elevated blood lead levels"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "both results exceeded CDC's current reference value of 5.0 µ g/dL."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "case report/series", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "These two cases highlight the potential for lead poisoning among refugee populations"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The kajal and the curry powder were collected and analyzed for lead content using Environmental Protection Agency method 200.8."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "In accordance with CDC guidelines, follow-up testing was performed on both patients approximately 1 month after the initial confirmatory testing."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["data_focus", "analytic_depth"]}
